title: EncodedState extension point (DRAFT bridge-draft-0)
description: DRAFT, OPTIONAL. Placeholder for O-001 (encoding in Rust or Python is undecided). If the team picks Rust encoding, an engine may attach this next to `state` in responses. If Python encodes, it is never sent. The sparse index+value shape follows the suggestion in docs/ENCODING-EVIDENCE.md but is only an example, not a decision; `format` names whatever encoder version is in use.

format.description: Encoder name and version, e.g. sparse-v0. Its meaning is defined by the encoder, not by the bridge.

size.description: Length of the dense vector this sparse form stands for.
